title: String Formatting
prompt:
Write a program that formats the string 'Hello, {}!' with the name 'John'. Print the formatted string to the console.
Sample Input: John
Sample Output: Hello, John!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that meets your requirements:
```python
name = "John"
formatted_string = "Hello, {}!"
formatted_string = formatted_string.format(name)
print(formatted_string)
```
When you run this program with the input "John", it will output:
```
Hello, John!
```
I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
